name: Z-API
description: Z-API WhatsApp gateway from Brazil: check the instance connection, browse chats and contacts, verify numbers on WhatsApp and send text, image and document messages through a WhatsApp number linked by QR code.
instructions:
Z-API is a third-party WhatsApp gateway: it runs a WhatsApp Web session for a number you link yourself. It is not Meta's official WhatsApp Business API, and WhatsApp may restrict or ban numbers that send in bulk.

**Getting credentials**
1. In the Z-API panel, open Instances, create or pick an instance and click edit. Copy the instance ID into `ZAPI_INSTANCE_ID` and the instance token into `ZAPI_INSTANCE_TOKEN`.
2. Open the Security tab, module Account Security Token, click Set Up Now and copy the token into `ZAPI_CLIENT_TOKEN`. Then click Activate Token so every request must carry it.
3. Link the phone first: scan the instance QR code in the panel with WhatsApp (Linked devices). Until then every send fails.

**Workflow**: call `z_api_get_status` first. `connected: false` means the QR code must be scanned again; `smartphoneConnected: false` means the phone is offline. Use `z_api_list_chats` or `z_api_check_phone_exists` to find the right recipient before sending.

**Formats**: phone numbers are digits only, country code + area code + number, no `+`, spaces or dashes: `5511999999999`. Group chats use their ID from `z_api_list_chats`, e.g. `120363019502650977-group`. Text supports `*bold*`, `_italic_` and `~strike~`. Images and documents are sent by public HTTPS URL; Z-API downloads them (files up to 100 MB).

**Sending**: the send tools write real WhatsApp messages. Always confirm the recipient and the exact text with the user before calling them, and never retry a send that returned a `messageId`. Messages go through a queue; `z_api_list_queue` shows what is still waiting.

**Pagination and limits**: chats and contacts take `page` and `pageSize` (both required by Z-API; the tools default to page 1). Ask for the next page until fewer results than `pageSize` come back. The queue uses the `pagingState` cursor until `hasMore` is false. Z-API sets no message cap, but WhatsApp watches the number: keep volumes modest and space sends minutes apart. Plans are billed per instance, with a 2-day free trial.

**Cloud reachability**: `api.z-api.io` is a public HTTPS API, reachable from AnythingMCP Cloud. If you enabled IP restriction in the Z-API Security tab, allow the AnythingMCP outbound address or turn the restriction off.

ZAPI_INSTANCE_ID.label: Instance ID
ZAPI_INSTANCE_ID.help: In the Z-API panel, open Instances and click edit on your instance; the ID is shown there.
ZAPI_INSTANCE_ID.patternMessage: Paste only the instance ID (letters and digits), not the full API URL.

ZAPI_INSTANCE_TOKEN.label: Instance token
ZAPI_INSTANCE_TOKEN.help: Shown next to the instance ID when you edit the instance in the Z-API panel.
ZAPI_INSTANCE_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste only the instance token, not the full API URL.

ZAPI_CLIENT_TOKEN.label: Account security token (Client-Token)
ZAPI_CLIENT_TOKEN.help: Z-API panel, Security tab, Account Security Token: Set Up Now, copy the token, then Activate Token.
ZAPI_CLIENT_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste only the security token, without spaces or a header name.

tools.name: z_api_get_status
tools.description: Check whether the Z-API instance is linked to a WhatsApp account and whether the phone is online. Call this first: connected false means the QR code must be scanned again in the Z-API panel.

tools.name: z_api_get_instance
tools.description: Get the Z-API instance name, connection flag, payment status and expiry date (Unix timestamp in `due`). Use it to explain why sending stopped, e.g. an unpaid or expired instance.

tools.name: z_api_get_device
tools.description: Get the phone linked to the instance: its number, profile name, device model and whether it is a WhatsApp Business account. Tells you which number messages are sent from.

tools.name: z_api_check_phone_exists
tools.description: Check whether a phone number has a WhatsApp account. Returns exists, the number as WhatsApp formats it and its private lid. Use it to validate a number a user typed, not before every send.

phone.description: Digits only: country code + area code + number, no + or spaces, e.g. 5511999999999.

tools.name: z_api_list_chats
tools.description: List the WhatsApp chats of the linked number (people and groups) with phone or group ID, name, unread count and last message time. Page through with page and pageSize.

page.description: Page number to fetch: 1, then 2, 3 and so on.

tools.name: z_api_get_chat
tools.description: Get metadata of one chat: unread count, last message time, mute and spam flags, profile status and notes (WhatsApp Business only). Chat message history is not available through Z-API.

phone.description: Contact number in digits only (e.g. 5511999999999) or a group ID from z_api_list_chats.

tools.name: z_api_list_contacts
tools.description: List WhatsApp contacts known to the linked number, including people from shared groups, with phone, saved name and WhatsApp profile name. Page through with page and pageSize.

page.description: Page number to fetch: 1, then 2, 3 and so on.

tools.name: z_api_list_queue
tools.description: List messages still waiting in the instance's send queue, with phone, text and IDs. Read-only. Continue with pagingState from the previous answer while hasMore is true.

pagingState.description: Cursor returned by the previous call; omit for the first page.

tools.name: z_api_send_text
tools.description: Send a WhatsApp text message to a contact or group from the linked number. This sends a real message: confirm the recipient number and the exact text with the user before calling, and do not retry after a messageId is returned.

phone.description: Recipient in digits only (country code + area code + number, e.g. 5511999999999) or a group ID.

message.description: Text to send. Supports *bold*, _italic_, ~strike~ and line breaks.

delayMessage.description: Optional wait before sending, 1 to 15 seconds.

delayTyping.description: Optional seconds to show 'typing...' before sending, 1 to 15.

tools.name: z_api_send_image
tools.description: Send an image by public HTTPS URL to a contact or group, with an optional caption. This sends a real message: confirm the recipient, the image and the caption with the user before calling.

phone.description: Recipient in digits only (e.g. 5511999999999) or a group ID.

image.description: Public HTTPS URL of the image, reachable by Z-API.

caption.description: Optional text shown under the image.

tools.name: z_api_send_document
tools.description: Send a document (PDF, XLSX, DOCX...) by public HTTPS URL to a contact or group. This sends a real message: confirm the recipient and the file with the user before calling.

extension.description: File extension without the dot, e.g. pdf, xlsx or docx.

phone.description: Recipient in digits only (e.g. 5511999999999) or a group ID.

document.description: Public HTTPS URL of the file, reachable by Z-API.

fileName.description: Optional name shown to the recipient, e.g. Invoice 1042.

caption.description: Optional description sent with the file.
